# Learning Coaching Center (L.C.C.) — Official Academic & Coaching Hub

> India's premier coaching institute in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh led by Director Aman Arora. Specializing in Class 9-12 Board Exam Toppers, NEET/JEE Foundation, Computer Diplomas (DCA, ADCA), and Spoken English.

## Key Facts
- **Full Name**: Learning Coaching Center (L.C.C. / LLC)
- **Alternate Names**: LLC Coaching, LCC Coaching, LCC Varanasi, Learning Coaching Center Varanasi
- **Director / Founder**: Aman Arora (Lead Academician with 10+ years coaching experience)
- **Headquarters**: Near City Central, Main Market Road, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh 221001, India
- **Geo Coordinates**: 25.3176° N, 82.9739° E
- **Contact Phone**: +91-98765-43210
- **Official Email**: admissions@lcc.edu
- **Official Website**: https://lcc-edu.vercel.app
- **Rating**: 4.9/5 stars (1500+ verified student reviews)
- **Board Exam Pass Rate**: 98.6%

## Academic Programs & Batches
- **Class 9th & 10th Foundation**: Science, Mathematics, English, Social Science with daily practice problems (DPPs).
- **Class 11th & 12th Science**: Physics, Chemistry, Maths & Biology (PCM/PCB) for CBSE/UP Board toppers.
- **Class 11th & 12th Commerce**: Accountancy, Economics, Business Studies.
- **Computer Diploma Courses**: DCA (Diploma in Computer Applications), ADCA, Tally Prime with 1:1 computer lab practicals.
- **Spoken English & Personality**: Accent training, grammar, debate clubs, public speaking by Aman Arora.
- **Competitive Entrance Foundations**: NEET, IIT-JEE Foundation, NTSE.

## Student Access & Online Enrollment
Online admissions are available 24/7 at https://lcc-edu.vercel.app. All payments are cryptographically verified through Razorpay with instant automated onboarding to the official batch WhatsApp community and private video lecture vault.
